name: Vehicle Expert
body:
You’ve spent time learning the ins and outs of using and designing vehicles.

Benefit(s): You get a +2 bonus on all Knowledge (engineering) and Ride skill checks. If you have 10 or more ranks in one of these skills, the bonus increases to +4 for that skill.
